Package frc.robot.auto.routineManager

Class RoutineManager

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.auto.routineManager.RoutineManager
public class RoutineManager extends Object
The RoutineManager class is responsible for managing autonomous routines. It allows routines to be registered dynamically via annotated methods, and provides a way to select and execute these routines through the SmartDashboard.

      Adds a new autonomous routine to the routineMap and the autoSelector.

      sendableName - The name of the routine as it will appear in the SmartDashboard.
      initMethod - A CommandSupplier that provides the command sequence for this routine.
